user_instruction_zh: 以后用户发来新消息时，先查看正在运行或最近完成的回测结果。
scope: Apply when this S500 conversation resumes or a future agent reads this project handoff; this record does not create an autonomous scheduler or guarantee unrelated chats inherit it.
check_on_each_project_message: Check relevant queued/in-progress/latest completed research runs and known run URLs. Account observers and trading cycles are not research jobs.
Read job outcome and locate the committed report/artifact at its producing code/input version; green workflow alone is not proof the backtest was valid or complete.
For new results check sample dates, universe coverage, funding and all restarts, costs/execution assumptions, end cash vs marked equity, drawdown, target hits and failures/incomplete paths.
Briefly tell the user what finished, failed or remains running; then continue their current request. Do not make the user ask for status again.
If still running, report last observed state rather than invented finish time or new profits. If failed, inspect cause before considering another run.
Record the last checked run IDs, result commit/hash and checked time; distinguish external authors results from independently verified results.
does_not_authorize: new scheduler or default-branch workflow deployment merely by recording this rule
orders, live trading, automatic funding resets or changes to separate100000-account automation
writing other agents folders or force-pushing
publication_boundary: Shared repository writes only exchange/codex/; inspect other reports read-only.
